title: Native Sessions journal, accepted facts, and owner delivery
alt: Events & Sessions commits journal facts and serves ordered replay. Orchestrator rechecks current Projects authority, accepted decision, persisted selection context, work item, turn, and Environment placement after waits. Owner-admitted forks commit verified journal lineage before child registration, while old provider pins deny forks. Native SDK observations require a validated bearer and separate Identity observe credential. Events fetches the source receipt by ID and commits immutable Cost accounting before acknowledgment, without multiplying weighted nano-AIU again. These local source contracts do not prove deployment, paid model execution, or physical runtime recovery.
